correctness.rationale: All weighted core Laplacian eigenspaces lift to two distinct monotone spectral branches with explicit pendant/core ratios. On each lower branch every nonnegative gain gives a nonzero observation row factor; upper branch factor vanishes exactly at b_s(alpha). PBH/eigenspace restriction gives the full invisible-dimension formula without assuming simple base spectrum. Connectedness excludes single-site eigenvectors, proving pairwise-distinct gain recovery. Analytic proof reconstructs all quantifiers; 18 exact homogeneous tests, 24 exact heterogeneous tests, three full-sensor exact resonance checks, two illustrative numerical cycle checks succeeded.

value.rationale: For an arbitrary connected base network with a leaf attached to each vertex, the exact unseen-state dimension is a useful structural observer-design invariant. It exposes a counterintuitive total-sensing blind spot at unit local aggregation and gives a universal explicit gain diversity strategy. It is a nontrivial classification of actual measurement mechanisms, not a routine numerical case or unmotivated parameter substitution; no noise robustness is claimed.
